concept: Review and integration: what listening, learning, and real apologies feel like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of listening to others, staying open to learning, and real apologies — which feels hardest for you?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'humility' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
